subject.title: fix(ios): render Markdown lists and thematic breaks

question: Which open implementation should be the canonical fix for iOS Markdown lists and thematic breaks: this broader nested-list renderer or the narrower implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111208?
rationale: Both branches target the same user problem but deliberately choose different parsing and fallback boundaries; that scope tradeoff needs owner judgment rather than automated consolidation.

options.title: Compare and select one canonical branch
options.body: Review both implementations against the desired supported Markdown subset, then land the selected branch and close or rebase the other.

options.title: Prefer the narrower implementation
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111208 if conservative top-level support is the intended reliability boundary, then follow up separately for nested-list rendering.

options.title: Adopt the broader implementation
options.body: Land this PR if nested lists, embedded code, and its bounded fallback are required for the intended iOS parity target, then close the competing branch as superseded.

recommendation.title: Compare and select one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Review both implementations against the desired supported Markdown subset, then land the selected branch and close or rebase the other.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comments and branch-integration commits show direct familiarity with the competing renderer semantics.
